patch_description: Replace the shared RY rotation (ry_shared on all wires) with a shared RX rotation (rx_shared on all wires), keeping the pre/post RZ sandwich structure and CZ chain intact. This isolates the single-qubit rotation axis as a variable to test whether RX provides better expressiveness, convergence, or parameter efficiency than RY for this specific learning task while maintaining perfect accuracy and generalization. The structure remains maximally minimal with only 3 unique parameters.
